description:
Render a Mermaid source string to themeable SVG. Returns { ok, svg }.
Layout is deterministic: identical input produces identical geometry. The hosted
boundary forces security:'strict' and embedFontImport:false.

jsonValue.description: A finite, acyclic JSON value without prototype keys.
jsonValue.x-agentic-mermaid-validation-expectation: a finite, acyclic JSON value without prototype keys

options.description: Shared advanced RenderOptions object. Styles accept a registered Look (crisp, hand-drawn, excalidraw, pen-and-ink, freehand, watercolor, blueprint, look:tufte, accessible-high-contrast, patent-drawing, status-dashboard, ops-schematic, chalkboard, risograph, architectural-plan, publication-figure), Palette (paper, dusk, zinc-light, zinc-dark, tokyo-night, tokyo-night-storm, tokyo-night-light, catppuccin-mocha, catppuccin-latte, nord, nord-light, dracula, github-light, github-dark, solarized-light, solarized-dark, one-dark, salmon, salmon-dark, tufte-dark), inline record, or left-to-right stack.

accent.description: Arrowhead, highlight, and data accent color.

architecture.description: Architecture renderer visual metric and paint overrides.

visual.description: Sparse architecture visual overrides merged over resolved defaults.

groupHeaderHeight.description: Requested minimum Architecture group-header height; expands to fit measured title text.

groupLabelPaddingX.description: Horizontal padding around architecture group labels.

architecture.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: this option configures graphical architecture rendering

class.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: this option configures graphical class layout

compact.description: Compact SVG serialization while preserving agent hooks.

componentSpacing.description: Spacing between disconnected graph components for compatible extension families; no built-in family currently consumes it.
componentSpacing.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal layout has a cell-grid spacing contract

embedFontImport.description: Embed the Google Fonts import in SVG styles; PNG forces this off for offline rasterization.
embedFontImport.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal output embeds no web-font import

font.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: the host terminal owns the font face

gantt.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: graphical Gantt connector emphasis is not represented in cells

ganttToday.description: Explicit deterministic date for the Gantt today marker.

anyOf.description: Owned graph layout with optional ELK fallback.

graphLayout.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: selects pixel placement and optional graphical companion evidence, not terminal-cell placement

idPrefix.description: Non-empty namespace for generated SVG definition IDs and local references.
idPrefix.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal output has no SVG definition ids

interactive.description: Enable hover tooltips for supported chart data points.
interactive.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal output is a static semantic projection

experienceCurve.description: Connect journey score markers with an experience curve.

maxWidth.description: Best-effort width budget for wrapping whole Kanban columns into rows.

kanban.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal layout uses its own targetWidth

layerSpacing.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal layout has a cell-grid spacing contract

layoutSafety.description: Require a passed final native layout certificate.

muted.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal themes have no dedicated muted-text role

nodeSpacing.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal layout has a cell-grid spacing contract

padding.description: Canvas padding in SVG user units.
padding.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal output uses paddingX, paddingY, and boxBorderPadding

maxWidth.description: Best-effort graphical width budget; authored legend placement retains precedence.

pie.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal layout uses its own targetWidth

maxWidth.description: Best-effort graphical width budget; authored frames retain precedence.

radar.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal layout uses its own targetWidth

security.description: Active SVG content is rejected in every mode; strict additionally rejects every external reference. Raw Mermaid themeCSS is rejected in both modes.
security.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal text has its own control-character and HTML-color safety projection

seed.description: Deterministic re-roll seed for stochastic Styles.
seed.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: terminal glyph geometry is deterministic and has no stochastic ink

shadow.description: Paint explicit drop shadows on node shapes.
shadow.x-agentic-mermaid-terminal-note: elevation projects to borders and labels
